item.title: GENE SIMMONS Confesses OZZY OSBOURNE Taught Him The One Lesson He Couldn’t Learn On Stage
item.description: Gene Simmons recently opened up about what he took away from decades of knowing Ozzy Osbourne. The KISS co-founder, now 75, reflected on the loss of Ozzy, who died July 22 at 76, during an appearance on David Duchovny’s podcast Fail Better.

item.title: Paul Stanley Reveals KISS’s Biggest Song of All Time: 'Massive Hit, Yet Unlike Anything We’d Done Before'
item.description: Paul Stanley isn’t hedging. He called “I Was Made for Lovin’ You” the biggest KISS song of all time, pointing to 1.3 billion Spotify streams and roughly 850,000 daily plays as of late August.

item.title: KISS Icon Gene Simmons Speaks Out on Reagan Movie Controversy
item.description: Gene Simmons—yes, the man with the tongue, the fire-breathing antics, and more merchandise than a small country—has added movie soundtrack contributor to his résumé. Recently, he recorded a cover of “Stormy Weather” for the biopic Reagan.
